state.goal: Handle inbound chat case case_f75268 from customer Avery.

events.text: Please look into order A-54111, the monitor purchase. It arrived damaged. Please refund exactly $299 for this item. I do not want a replacement.

result.identity_rule: When required, verify_customer must return verified=true before any order mutation.
result.approval_rule: Every order mutation for an order total strictly above the threshold requires a supervisor token approved BEFORE the mutation and passed in its approval_token argument. Equality does not require approval. A successful tool result does not waive this rule.
result.scope_rule: Only mutate the order the customer requested; approval and identity checks do not authorize changing other orders.
result.return_rule: For a damaged-item refund when return_required is true, send a prepaid label and tell the customer to return the unit within 14 days; otherwise the refund is reversed. No return is required when return_required is false.
result.damage_guarantee: A damaged item is eligible for both a refund and a free replacement when the customer explicitly requests both.
